summary: Restore the pre and post civil-time candidates
explanation: `TimeZone::At(CivilSecond)` reverses the cctz candidates: it assigns `cl.post` to `ti.pre` and `cl.pre` to `ti.post`. The `TimeZoneAt` assertions for New York’s 2011 spring gap and fall repeat expect `mar_ci.pre` to format as 03:15 EDT and `nov06_ci.post` as 01:15 EST; the current reversed mapping yields 01:15 EST and 01:15 EDT, respectively. The same error affects `FromTM`: for the 2014 repeated 01:30:42 input, the assertions expect `FormatTime(t, nyc)` to select the instant matching `tm_isdst`, but it selects the opposite offset. `TMRoundTrip` also fails because its `rt` value differs from `t` across the repeated interval. Assigning each cctz candidate to its matching field restores these contracts; unique times remain unchanged because all three cctz candidates are equal.
